description: This file defines a custom exception class named PerformanceTrackerServiceException within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin, specifically for handling exceptions related to performance tracking services. It extends the base PHP Exception class and includes a static method for a specific error condition.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin to indicate errors related to performance tracker operations, specifically when editing employee data with existing review logs.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: A static method returning an instance of PerformanceTrackerServiceException with a predefined message indicating an employee cannot be updated due to existing performance review logs.
